description: Maya is organizing her aunt's 60th-birthday gathering at Maya's home and must make the final call about the event format, guest count, dessert, and food-safety plan after checking in with two relatives.

agents.name: Maya
agents.role: Birthday Gathering Coordinator and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: Maya's aunt is turning 60 this Saturday.
shared_context.S2: The gathering will take place at Maya's home, which can comfortably host up to 10 people.
shared_context.S3: Maya is finalizing the event format, the number of attendees, the dessert, and the food-safety arrangements.
shared_context.S4: As the family usually does when organizing a celebration, Maya goes around the table before settling the plan so everyone can raise anything that should shape it.

PF1.text: The aunt sent Jonah a voice message saying she wants a quiet brunch with exactly 8 people including herself, no surprise reveal or speeches, and a lemon tart instead of a birthday cake; Jonah has not played the message for the group.

PF2.text: Leila's son Noah will attend and has a medically diagnosed sesame allergy, so every dish must be sesame-free and served with separate utensils; Leila has not yet raised this at the planning table.

acceptance_conditions: The gathering must be a quiet brunch.
Exactly 8 people, including the aunt, must attend.
There must be no surprise reveal.
The dessert must be a lemon tart.
A commitment must confirm that the gathering will be quiet and have no speeches or surprise reveal.
A commitment must confirm separate serving utensils for the sesame-free food.
Jonah's account of the aunt's request must be cited in the justification.

decisive_facts.why: The aunt's voice message changes the format to a quiet brunch, fixes attendance at exactly 8, rules out a surprise reveal, replaces cake with a lemon tart, and requires the quiet no-speeches commitment.
Noah's diagnosed sesame allergy changes the food plan from an ordinary menu to sesame-free food and adds the requirement for separate serving utensils.
